sources.title: Duchi Hazan Singer AdaGrad
sources.scope: Read original 39-page paper, diagonal Algorithm1 and history-dependent geometry; course uses an explicitly stated unconstrained special case.

sources.title: Tieleman Hinton RMSProp lecture
sources.scope: Read slide29 of31, exponential average of squared gradients and square-root scaling; no source images reused.

sources.title: Kingma Ba Adam
sources.scope: Read Algorithm1 and initialization-bias discussion. Checked time index, raw second moment, correction and epsilon outside root; broad original convergence claims not assumed.

sources.title: Loshchilov Hutter AdamW
sources.scope: Read section2 Algorithms1/2 and equivalence/non-equivalence statements. Explicitly distinguish paper per-step decay notation from the eta-times-lambda convention used here.

sources.title: Reddi Kale Kumar convergence limits
sources.scope: Read abstract/introduction of23-page original paper for convex-counterexample and earlier-analysis limitations. No implemented AMSGrad or broad guarantee claimed.

sources.title: PyTorch2.7 Adam
sources.scope: Read fixed-version API, update, decoupled flag and state semantics; actual2.7.1 CPU signature and single-tensor source also inspected.

sources.title: PyTorch2.7 AdamW
sources.scope: Read fixed-version update order, explicit weight decay and differing default. Actual2.7.1 CPU float64 state parity and zero-vs-None experiments executed; see library-result.json.

implementation_inspection.scope: Confirmed square-root then epsilon, initial accumulators, EMA update order, and decoupled old-parameter shrink. Actual pinned CPU float64 execution compared full parameters and optimizer states in 15 thirty-step cases; see library-result.json.
